reviews.text: Pet parents, beware: You may find yourself experiencing a new level of peace and joy due to Dog Bone. Since hiring them to walk my dog several times per week, the quality of life of my household has increased dramatically. Trust and confidence do not come easy, but Dog Bone has earned mine. I am so happy that Maia has new walking buddies who provide a detailed report of what transpired during each walk. Outstanding!
Good luck buddy, make this world a kinder place!

Dog Bone has been an absolute lifesaver for me and my dog, Cash! With my busy work schedule, I was worried about finding someone I could trust to take care of him, but Dog Bone has exceeded all my expectations. Scott and his team are incredibly professional, reliable, and clearly passionate about animals.

Every time I come home, Cash is happy, well-exercised, and relaxed, which speaks volumes about the care and attention he receives. One of the things I love most is how they provide photos and tracking of their walks. Seeing Cash’s happy face and knowing exactly where he’s been gives me peace of mind while I’m at work.

If you’re looking for a pet care company that treats your furry friend like family and goes the extra mile, look no further than Dog Bone. They’ve earned my trust completely, and I can’t recommend them enough!

Would 100% recommend to anyone. I have been using Scott and his team since May and they have always been reliable. They haven’t missed a walk nor have they been late - always on time! I use them about 4-5 times a week while at work and they are very trustworthy and loving if your pup. And the journal entries every day are a plus!
